# Complete r1 diagnostic tables

**R1 is SHARED_LOAD_DIAGNOSTIC in full.** Foreign CPU work was observed at its tail and the exact overlap is unknown. The frozen FRESH_HOST_CLEAN_SCREEN field records original intent. ROOT-R1-SHARED-LOAD-DECISION.json fixes the before-results decision. No samples are trimmed, cohorts are separate, and no final speed conclusion is supported before the full r2 repeat.

Each entry shows median [min, max] of ten retained observations. Absolute units are milliseconds per whole command for backend/client/SQL metrics and per fixed inner loop batch for AM-loop metrics. Pair entries are median [min, max] percent from ten direct round pairs; negative is faster. They are not percentages of absolute medians. Full arrays, mean/stdev/MAD and all ten role pairs remain in the original analyzer JSON. The six displayed pairs include all planned layout/memo comparisons, K4/B and exact-twin T/B.
